  PROBLEM: The header comment of close_completed_tracking_issue_if_ready says a reopened issue is only closed again "unless saving that state failed twice after the close". Only the post_state_comment POST is retried (`elif ! post_state_comment && ! post_state_comment`), and the jq/mv write of `.tracking_auto_close` to STATE_FILE is tried once, so a single failure there sets state_persist="failed" at once.
  WHY: The warning and state_persist=failed still fire, so behaviour is the same. But the comment is wrong about the hazard it was rewritten to describe, and maintainers will rely on it. openai_gpt-6-luna adds that one failed local write leaves `.tracking_auto_close` unsaved, so a later tick can PATCH a reopened issue closed again. Every reviewer rated this NIT, mapped here to low.

  WHY: If the state save fails after the PATCH, the next tick rebuilds STATE_FILE without `.tracking_auto_close`. The trusted close-marker comment only suppresses the comment POST, so the PATCH closes the reopened issue again, and the only signal is a ::warning:: in the poller log. Every reviewer rated this NIT, mapped here to low.
